ai.title: AI
ai.keyNeeded: Save an {provider} API key below to enable AI features.
ai.displayNamePlaceholder: For example: vLLM on the NAS
ai.baseUrlHelp: The Inventory Atlas server connects to this address, not your browser, so {localhost} means the machine or container running Inventory Atlas. For a model server on another computer, use its LAN address, for example {example}.
ai.insecure: This remote address uses plain HTTP, so the API key and your inventory data are sent unencrypted. Prefer HTTPS outside your local network.
ai.keySaved: Saved key: {key}. Leave this blank to keep it.
ai.keyStale: The saved key belongs to the previous provider or base URL and is removed when you save, unless you enter it again.

openai.help: Uses the OpenAI API with structured outputs. Only the recommended models available to your key are listed.

openrouter.help: Routes requests to many hosted models. The model list shows which models accept images.

ollama.help: A local Ollama server. No API key is normally needed. For photos, choose a vision model such as llava or qwen2.5vl.

lmstudio.help: The LM Studio local server. An API key is only needed when authentication is enabled in LM Studio.

custom.label: Custom OpenAI-compatible
custom.help: Any endpoint that implements the OpenAI-style /models and /chat/completions API.

backup.title: Data / Backup
backup.subtitle: Keep your own copies of the inventory database, and restore one when you need it.
backup.downloadText: Download a consistent snapshot containing all items, categories, custom fields, photos, and item templates.
backup.cloudHint: To upload the same snapshot to Dropbox or Google Drive, now or on a schedule, use {link}.
backup.restoredSafety: The database that was replaced was saved as {file} in the pre-restore backup directory. Opening the items list…
backup.restoreText: Replace the whole inventory with a backup downloaded from this application. The file is checked on the server before anything is changed.
backup.fileHelp: An Inventory Atlas Lite SQLite backup, normally named {name} ({extensions}). The contents are validated, not the file name.
backup.compatibleUpgraded: Compatible with this application (schema {schema}), upgraded from an older backup
backup.warningReplaced: All current items, categories, custom fields, values, photos, and item templates are replaced by this backup.
backup.warningLost: Everything added or changed after this backup was created disappears from the active database.
backup.warningSafety: The current database is saved automatically as a pre-restore safety backup on the server first.
backup.warningReload: The application briefly becomes unavailable for changes and then reloads.
backup.expires: The validated file is kept on the server for {n} minute. After that, validate it again. | The validated file is kept on the server for {n} minutes. After that, validate it again.
backup.whereLive: The live database is stored in {file}, or in the directory set through {variable}. Photos are inside the same file, so the snapshot is the whole inventory.
backup.whereCopies: Keep regular copies outside this server. Pre-restore safety backups are written to {restoreDir} next to the live database, and the ten most recent are kept. Pre-reset safety backups are written to {resetDir} and are never removed automatically.

reset.title: Reset Inventory Database
reset.text: Permanently remove all inventory items, photos, categories, custom fields, and item templates, and return Inventory Atlas Lite to a fresh database state.
reset.preserved: Application settings are preserved. A safety backup will be created automatically before reset.
reset.ready: Inventory Atlas Lite is ready for a fresh inventory.
reset.safety: A safety backup of the removed inventory was saved as {file} in the pre-reset backup directory. Opening the items list…
reset.impact: This permanently removes the whole current inventory:
reset.safetyText: Application settings, including the AI settings and API key, are preserved. A safety backup of the current database is written to {dir} on the server before anything is removed, and the reset stops if that backup cannot be created and verified.
reset.acknowledge: I understand that all inventory data will be permanently removed.
reset.expires: This confirmation is valid for {n} minute. | This confirmation is valid for {n} minutes.
